record.question: He yielded to temptation.
record.explanation: Answer C: resisted. Yielded to temptation means gave in/succumbed; resisted is the opposite (C). Independent check: To yield to temptation is to give in; “resisted” is the direct opposite. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/yield. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
